scope: Prepared CPU stage control; per-call estimate from fixed call count; no pipeline/service/additive claim.

clean.interpretation: Descriptive process CPU-time / wall-time; no CPU clock or scheduler trace; no clipping.

attacked.interpretation: Descriptive process CPU-time / wall-time; no CPU clock or scheduler trace; no clipping.

clean.limits: PDH intervals include metadata/warmup; two images; correlated repeats; no exact clock or causal inference.

attacked.limits: PDH intervals include metadata/warmup; two images; correlated repeats; no exact clock or causal inference.
